[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 1: Introduction to Public Policy Analysis - Overview of Public Policy Analysis; Key Details: Defining public policy, understanding the policy process, identifying policy actors, and analyzing policy outcomes; Assessment: In-class discussion and reflection paper.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 2: Understanding the Policy Process - Policy Formulation; Key Details: Identifying policy problems, setting policy goals, and selecting policy instruments; Assessment: Group presentation and written analysis.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 3: Understanding the Policy Process - Policy Implementation; Key Details: Examining policy tools, actors and implementation strategies, and evaluating implementation outcomes; Assessment: In-class discussion and written reflection.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 4: Understanding the Policy Process - Policy Evaluation; Key Details: Measuring policy impact, identifying evaluation criteria, and assessing policy effectiveness; Assessment: Written policy evaluation and group presentation.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 5: Analyzing Policy Actors - Stakeholders and Interest Groups; Key Details: Examining the role of stakeholders, understanding interest group politics, and analyzing their influence on policy decisions; Assessment: In-class simulation and reflection paper.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 6: Analyzing Policy Actors - Political Institutions; Key Details: Understanding the role of government institutions, legislative and executive powers, and their impact on policy-making; Assessment: Group presentation and written analysis.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 7: Analyzing Policy Actors - Bureaucracies; Key Details: Examining the role of bureaucracies, understanding bureaucratic politics, and analyzing their influence on policy implementation; Assessment: In-class discussion and written reflection.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 8: Policy Analysis Techniques - Cost-Benefit Analysis; Key Details: Defining cost-benefit analysis, understanding its application, and analyzing its limitations; Assessment: Individual policy analysis paper.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 9: Policy Analysis Techniques - Multi-Criteria Analysis; Key Details: Defining multi-criteria analysis, understanding its application, and analyzing its limitations; Assessment: Individual policy analysis paper.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 10: Policy Analysis Techniques - Stakeholder Analysis; Key Details: Defining stakeholder analysis, understanding its application, and analyzing its limitations; Assessment: Individual policy analysis paper.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 11: Policy Analysis Techniques - Scenario Analysis
